11267-125024 is a generic INPUT WARNING state and belongs in @skai/ui: a labelled field (Email / vassimo@skai.trade) with a visible icons/warnings glyph inside the field and a hidden message slot carrying "This password encrypts your private key. It is the only way ...". SkaiInput has the right structure and a state union at input.tsx:118 = "normal"|"active"|"focus"|"completed"|"error" - but grep -c "hover:" is 0 and grep -ci "warn" is 0 across all 294 lines. A warning is genuinely NOT the existing "error" state: error is terminal and blocks submit, warning is advisory. Needs a sixth union member plus the amber token.

11267-125066 is MIS-NAMED and is not a plain input hover state. At 795x76 it is the CONNECTED-WALLET ROW from the Security screen 5529-49244 (avatar circle + "BSC Returns" + 0x47CF...B292 + a "Make primary" action revealed on hover), built out of the input/primary-inputs component with its label hidden. So it needs BOTH halves: the missing hover treatment in SkaiInput (grep -c "hover:" = 0) AND a "Make primary" action on the linked-wallets list, which renders in SettingsTab.tsx:920-982 and has no primary-wallet concept. Do not build this as a bare input state.
